cards.ex: The match was called off due to torrential rain.
cards.exUz: O'yin kuchli jala sababli bekor qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli, shiddatli yomg'ir yog'ishi, seldek quyish.

cards.ex: It's bitterly cold outside; wear a warm coat.
cards.exUz: Tashqari juda sovuq; iliq palto kiying.

cards.ex: We had freak weather last summer – snow in July!
cards.exUz: O'tgan yozda g'alati ob-havo bo'ldi - iyulda qor!

cards.ex: I got caught in the rain and now I'm soaking wet.
cards.exUz: Yomg'irga tushib qoldim va hozir butunlay ho'lman.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay ho'l bo'lib ketgan, suvi chiqib turgan.

cards.ex: The hurricane wreaked havoc on the coastal towns.
cards.exUz: To'fon qirg'oq shaharlariga katta zarar yetkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Katta zarar yetkazish, vayronagarchilik keltirib chiqarish (ob-havo haqida).

cards.ex: We spent the day at the beach under the scorching sun.
cards.exUz: Biz kuni bo'yi qizdiruvchi quyosh ostida plyajda o'tkazdik.

cards.ex: Hikers need to be prepared to face the elements.
cards.exUz: Sayyohlar ob-havo sharoitlariga bardosh berishga tayyor bo'lishlari kerak.

cards.ex: The insurance company classified the flood as an act of God.
cards.exUz: Sug'urta kompaniyasi suv toshqinini tabiiy ofat deb tasnifladi.
cards.uzDef: Inson nazorat qila olmaydigan tabiiy hodisa.

cards.ex: We walked home under a leaden sky, anticipating rain.
cards.exUz: Biz yomg'irni kutib, xira osmon ostida uyga qarab yurdim.

cards.ex: The drought is starting to take its toll on the crops.
cards.exUz: Qurg'oqchilik ekinlarga zarar yetkazmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir salbiy ta'siri bo'lishi, zarar yetkazishi.

cards.ex: After the rain, there was a burst of sunshine.
cards.exUz: Yomg'irdan keyin quyosh nuri paydo bo'ldi.

cards.ex: Scientists are studying long-term weather patterns.
cards.exUz: Olimlar uzoq muddatli ob-havo namunalarini o'rganishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ob-havoning vaqt o'tishi bilan takrorlanadigan tendensiyalari.

cards.ex: The island remains untouched, as nature intended.
cards.exUz: Orol tabiat xohlaganidek, daxlsiz qolgan.

cards.ex: Environmental degradation is a serious global issue.
cards.exUz: Ekologik buzilish jiddiy global muammo.

cards.ex: We experienced a deluge of rain last night.
cards.exUz: Kechasi juda ko'p yomg'ir yog'di.

cards.ex: I love experiencing the four seasons in this country.
cards.exUz: Men bu mamlakatda to'rt faslni his qilishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Yilning to'rt davri: bahor, yoz, kuz, qish.

cards.ex: We found a beautiful waterfall off the beaten track.
cards.exUz: Biz odamlardan uzoqda, chiroyli sharshara topdik.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur joylardan uzoqda, kam odam boradigan joyda.

cards.ex: Nature is a force to be reckoned with, especially during storms.
cards.exUz: Tabiat - bu hisoblashadigan kuch, ayniqsa bo'ron paytida.
cards.term: a force to be reckoned with
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy e'tiborga olinishi kerak bo'lgan kuch (tabiatda).

cards.ex: The tornado left a swathe of destruction in its wake.
cards.exUz: Tornado ketidan katta vayron bo'lgan hudud qoldirdi.

cards.ex: It's bucketing down outside; I'm not going anywhere.
cards.exUz: Tashqarida chelaklab yomg'ir yog'yapti; men hech qayerga bormayman.

cards.ex: We love spending weekends in the great outdoors.
cards.exUz: Biz dam olish kunlarini tabiat qo'ynida o'tkazishni yaxshi ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatda ochiq havoda, qishloq joylarda vaqt o'tkazish.

cards.ex: The sailors were at the mercy of the storm.
cards.exUz: Dengizchilar bo'ronning rahm-shafqatiga muhtoj edilar.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir kuchli ta'siri ostida, himoyasiz qolish.

cards.ex: We waited for a break in the weather to go hiking.
cards.exUz: Biz piyoda sayr qilish uchun ob-havoning yaxshilanishini kutdik.

cards.ex: We had a light shower this morning, but it soon passed.
cards.exUz: Bugun ertalab engil yomg'ir yog'di, lekin tezda o'tib ketdi.

cards.ex: We need to protect the natural world for future generations.
cards.exUz: Kelajak avlodlar uchun tabiiy olamni himoya qilishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: There were weather-related delays at the airport today.
cards.exUz: Bugun aeroportda ob-havo bilan bog'liq kechikishlar bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ob-havo sharoiti tufayli yuzaga keladigan kechikishlar.

cards.ex: I'm going to the beach to catch some rays.
cards.exUz: Men quyoshlanish uchun plyajga bormoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Quyosh nurida dam olish, quyosh vannasini qabul qilish.

cards.ex: Environmental awareness is increasing among young people.
cards.exUz: Yoshlar orasida ekologik ong o'sib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhit muammolari haqida xabardorlik va mas'uliyat.

cards.ex: We sailed in the teeth of a strong gale.
cards.exUz: Biz kuchli bo'ronga qarshi suzib bordik.

cards.ex: We're having a spell of warm weather this week.
cards.exUz: Bu hafta bizda iliq ob-havo davri bo'lmoqda.
